text:
Khalid (PM): planning thread for regional-safety-lattice rollout of "session-fallback v3". goal: low-risk NA opt-in alpha, EU shadow, then APAC gated. enterprise tenants get pre-approval gating.
Becca (Eng): proposed flow: 1) EU shadow 10% for 48h, collect quality + cost; 2) NA visible opt-in 5% -> 25% with manual gate; 3) full ramp only after metrics stable. variant B uses new routing + KV caching + quantized backup.
Omar (SRE): canary infra: reserve a small warm pool in eu-west and us-east. alarms: sustained p99 > 350ms OR 5xx > 0.5% for 10m -> auto-fallback. fallback sequence: try quantized variant (2m), if unhealthy then baseline. add per-tenant kill switch + audit log.
Lina (Data): metrics to instrument: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, token-cost delta, 200-sample human eval subset, automated quality delta on seeded eval. estimate: 9k requests/arm to detect 1.3% delta. I'll attach dashboards.
Khalid (PM): rollout gates: smoke at 5% (no infra alarms, quality delta <=1.3%), manual approval at 25%. require runbook and enterprise comms for tenants with SLA clauses.
Becca (Eng): flag proto for ops: {"flag":"session_fallback_v3","mode":"opt_in","variants":["baseline","v3"],"initial_split":{"region":"NA","ratio":0.05},"shadow":{"region":"EU","ratio":0.10},"kill_switch":"global_off"} (pasted to ops repo).
Omar (SRE): will add throttle guard: rolling qps cap per-region and a burst cushion to avoid noisy neighbor issues. will schedule pre-canary 15m ops review.
launch-bot: scheduled shadow-start: 2026-06-12T03:00Z, visible-start NA: 2026-06-16T14:00Z
Lina (Data): dashboard PR + eval set by EOD Thu.
Becca (Eng): infra TODOs: implement shadow routing, flag schema, add runtime fallback hooks.
Omar (SRE): SRE TODOs: alarm rules, per-tenant audit entries, canary pool scheduling.
Khalid (PM): comms: drafting tenant notes and rollback FAQ. enterprise request: Customer Y needs EU-only opt-out and signed pre-approval; we'll add tenant metadata to flag and require a pre-approval marker before visible split.
Becca (Eng): we'll implement a pre-approve tag on tenant metadata that the rollout system checks before assigning visible variant.
Khalid (PM): target soft launch week: 2026-06-15. any blockers? :eyes:
Becca (Eng): none on eng side.
Omar (SRE): will block if canary pool isn't reserved or if alarm gaps remain.
Lina (Data): on track.
Khalid (PM): thanks all — i'll post final runbook + checklist in #launchroom once infra PRs land.
